calls.title: Hawaii planning
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the company's revenue performance, which is currently projecting $13-15 million, falling short of the $18-20 million target due to slipped deals. Discussion highlighted a significant drop in conversion rates after doubling the Pro product price, despite a $200,000 revenue increase. Customer churn, particularly among small buyers, was noted as a concern, emphasizing the need for dedicated ownership of retention metrics. The team also aims to grow self-serve business to 35% to minimize reliance on sales reps. Offsite planning included key workshops focused on product feedback and AI messaging, with a goal to streamline communication between sales, product, and engineering teams for improved alignment.
calls.keywords: sales enablement, pro business retention, growth planning, AI messaging, product feedback, Hawaii planning
